label: Egypt pyramids + Nile
summary: Giza pyramids + GEM; fly to Aswan: Nubian guesthouse, felucca, Nile birding; drive via Kom Ombo/Edfu to Luxor; EgyptAir red-eye CAI-NBO, lands ~02:00-05:00 Dec 28.
verdict: Biggest wow per dollar: pyramids, GEM, Valley of the Kings, ~$1,400-1,450 pp extra incl. flight delta. Culture week, not wildlife; costs: Christmas crowds, touts, pre-dawn Dec 21 arrival, long Dec 27 + 5h red-eye.

safety.advisory_level: US State Dept Level 2: Increased Caution (terrorism, crime, health), countrywide. Level 4 Do Not Travel: North/Central Sinai (terrorism), Western Desert (smuggling, remoteness), border areas incl. Libya, Sudan. Recheck travel.state.gov before booking; 2026 US-Iran/Israel tensions, fragile ceasefire.
safety.summary: Cairo/Giza, Aswan, Luxor: heavily policed tourist corridors, far from Do Not Travel zones; UK/Australia agree. Real risks: scams, touts, overcharging, traffic, stomach bugs, verbal harassment of women; checkpoints at sites. No Sinai/Western Desert (no Siwa, White Desert, Bahariya); optional Fayoum/Wadi El-Hitan only with licensed operator after advisory check.
precautions: Stay out of North/Central Sinai, Western Desert, borders. Plan stays in Nile Valley.
Giza: enter via Pyramids Visitor Centre (free shuttle) or Sphinx gate. Ignore 'gate closed'/'police' hustlers; camel price in writing, incl. return.
Cairo: Uber/Careem, no street taxis. ~04:00 CAI pickup via Giza guesthouse.
Small EGP for baksheesh, toilets. Fees by card at official windows (many card-only). GEM online only (visit-gem.com).
Bottled water only; no street salads/ice; pack rehydration salts.
Enroll STEP. Carry passport copy for checkpoints.
Aswan-Luxor driver via guesthouse; police may impose convoy timing, follow driver.
Dual US-Egyptian nationals: limited consular help (only if Egyptian citizen).

visa: US passport: VOA at CAI, single entry, 30 days, US$30 since Mar 1 2026 (was $25), USD cash at bank kiosk before immigration. Alt: e-visa visa2egypt.gov.eg ($25 or $30, sources conflict); avoid resellers. Passport 6+ months valid. Kenya eTA already in base trip.
weather_dec: Ideal. Cairo: 19-21C days, 9-11C nights, some haze/smog. Aswan/Luxor: 23-26C sunny days, 7-10C nights; fleece for felucca, early starts. No rain. Peak crowds, esp. Dec 24-31.
highlights: Giza pyramids + Sphinx at opening; pyramid-view guesthouse, rooftop breakfast
Grand Egyptian Museum (opened 2025): full Tutankhamun collection
Aswan: sunset felucca, Elephantine/Kitchener's Island; birding boat through First Cataract islands
Christmas Eve in Nubian village guesthouse, Gharb Soheil
Kom Ombo (crocodile temple, croc mummy museum) + Edfu, Egypt's best-preserved temple
Luxor: Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut, Karnak; optional sunrise balloon
MS849 direct CAI-NBO red-eye, no Istanbul backtrack
drawbacks: Weak wildlife: Nile birds only (kingfishers, egrets, kites, hoopoes). No big game, no primates.
Christmas week = peak. Crowds; Christmas lodging sells out, book now.
Heavy touts, tipping demands at Giza, Luxor.
TK10 lands IST ~19:00; only TK692 01:55 (TK694 18:25 leaves earlier). ~7h layover, CAI ~03:30-04:30 Dec 21. Alt: Europe routing or YOTEL Air pod.
Long Dec 27: early-afternoon LXR flight, hours at CAI, red-eye. MS849 dep 21:35/22:55/23:55, lands NBO ~02:35-04:55; reconfirm.
Abu Simbel skipped: ~7h round trip by road; flight ~$250-350 pp upgrade.
Upgrades: dahabiya 3-4 nights ~$250-450 pppn, 3-night cruise $400+ pp; Egyptologist ~$40-60/day/group.
Entry fees jumped 2025-26, sources conflict; budget is estimate.
Open-jaw: separate CAI-NBO one-way means misconnect risk is yours; low, 4-day buffer.

legs.detail: TK10 daily B777-300ER, LAX 19:45 (winter sked from Oct 24 2026) → IST 19:00 Dec 20. Reconfirm.
TK692 daily A330, IST 01:55 Dec 21 after ~7h layover → CAI ~03:20-04:20 (UTC+2). TK694 (18:25) leaves before TK10 lands. VOA $30 cash.
Guesthouse pre-dawn pickup (~$20-25/car) to Nazlet el-Semman. Empty roads.
Early Uber to domestic terminal. Pad for traffic.
Private car + driver via guesthouse (~$90-120/car). Leave ~8am; Kom Ombo 1h, Edfu 1.5h; Luxor West Bank late afternoon.
EgyptAir LXR-CAI early afternoon, land CAI by ~17:00 for any MS849 time. ~$60-120.
MS849 daily B737-800. CAI 23:55 → NBO 04:55 Dec 28 per trackers; some dates 20:55, Dec snapshots 21:35 (lands ~02:35). All land before 06:00. Reconfirm.

stays.label: Pyramid-view guesthouse, Giza (Dec 20 night held for ~05:00 Dec 21 check-in)

itinerary.title: IST layover
itinerary.details: Land ~19:00. ~7h airside: lounge, food, optional YOTEL Air pod. TK692 01:55.

itinerary.title: Pre-dawn arrival, rest, GEM
itinerary.details: Land CAI ~03:30-04:30. VOA $30 cash. Pickup ~45 min; room ready (Dec 20 prebooked). Sleep till noon. Optional late GEM (10-15 min Uber, 2-3h) or tomorrow. Early night.
itinerary.meals: B guesthouse late; L/D local koshari/grill

itinerary.title: Pyramids + Sphinx
itinerary.details: Gate ~7-8am, beat crowds. Visitor Centre shuttle, panorama, Sphinx; optional Khufu interior. Back 1pm, nap. PM: GEM if skipped, or Saqqara (40 min). Rooftop evening.

itinerary.title: Fly to Aswan, sunset felucca
itinerary.details: Uber ~1h to CAI, fly ~1h25. Car ~30 min + ferry to west bank. Felucca 1-2h, Elephantine/Kitchener's, birds. ~3.5h travel.
itinerary.meals: B guesthouse; L/D Nubian home cooking

itinerary.title: Philae + birding (Christmas Eve)
itinerary.details: AM: Philae (taxi 20 min + boat 10 min). PM: ~2h birding boat, First Cataract; Botanical Island walk. Christmas Eve dinner at guesthouse. Easy.

itinerary.title: Temple road (Christmas)
itinerary.details: Car 8am. Kom Ombo 1h, Edfu 1.5h. ~4h driving; Luxor West Bank ~16:00. Relax.
itinerary.meals: B guesthouse; L roadside Edfu; D guesthouse

itinerary.title: Valley of the Kings
itinerary.details: Optional balloon 05:30. VoK (3 tombs), Hatshepsut, Colossi by taxi/bike, done 1pm. Rest. Evening: lit Luxor Temple (ferry 10 min).
itinerary.meals: B guesthouse; L local; D east bank

itinerary.title: Karnak, fly out
itinerary.details: Karnak at opening (~6-7am), 2h. Checkout. LXR-CAI ~13:00-15:00, 1h05. Wait CAI T3. MS849 21:35-23:55 (reconfirm) → NBO ~5h, lands ~02:35-04:55 Dec 28. Dec 28 Nairobi rest.
itinerary.meals: B guesthouse; L Luxor/airport; D CAI airport

lodging.name: Pyramid-view guesthouse, Nazlet el-Semman (e.g. Pyramids View Inn / Great Pyramid Inn type)
lodging.location: Nazlet el-Semman, Giza, next to the Sphinx gate
lodging.includes: Rooftop breakfast, pyramid view. Airport pickup extra; essential for ~04:00 arrival.
lodging.why: Walk to Sphinx gate, 10-15 min to GEM, no Cairo traffic. Great value. Book Dec 20 night for pre-dawn arrival. Basic rooms, noisy touty street.
lodging.alternatives: Upgrade: Marriott Mena House ($250+/room). Downtown hostels cheaper, 1h away.

lodging.name: Nubian guesthouse, Gharb Soheil / Elephantine (e.g. Anakato-area or Bet El Kerem style)
lodging.includes: Breakfast; dinners on request; boat transfers
lodging.why: Colorful, quiet Nubian village on Nile; calm Christmas Eve. Hosts arrange felucca, birding boat, Luxor car.
lodging.alternatives: Splurge: Old Cataract (Sofitel Legend, $400+). Dahabiya Aswan-Luxor (3-4 nights, $250-450 pppn) replaces car + hotels.

lodging.name: Nour El Gourna Hotel (or similar West Bank guesthouse)
lodging.location: Gourna, Luxor West Bank, near the Valley of the Kings
lodging.why: Walk/bike to VoK side, near balloon launch, quieter than east bank. Long-running budget favorite.
lodging.alternatives: Boutique: Al Moudira ($150+/room). East-bank Nile-view mid-range $40-70/room.

budget.item: LAX-IST-CAI (TK10 Dec 19 + TK692 Dec 21), CAI-NBO MS849 (Dec 27), NBO-IST-LAX TK608/TK9 (Jan 16)
budget.notes: ~+$450 pp vs $1,500 base. Best: one Star Alliance ticket incl. MS849 (turkishairlines.com or agent). Fallback: TK open-jaw LAX→CAI/NBO→LAX (~$1,550-1,800) + EgyptAir CAI-NBO one-way (~$200-350; peak budget $275-415). Estimates; price now.
EgyptAir/Nile Air. Cheaper, harder: Abela/Watania sleeper train ~$90-110 pp, 13h.

budget.item: 7 guesthouse nights (3 Giza incl. Dec 20 hold, 2 Aswan, 2 Luxor), shared double
budget.notes: 3x$25 + 2x$30 + 2x$25. Christmas peak, book now. High = mid-range Nile-view.

budget.item: GEM, Giza, Philae, Kom Ombo, Edfu, VoK, Hatshepsut, Karnak, Luxor Temple
budget.notes: 2026 foreigner EGP: GEM 1,450 (online only), Giza 700, VoK 750, Karnak 600, Luxor Temple 500, Hatshepsut 440, + Philae, Kom Ombo, Edfu. Total ~5,800-6,500 EGP; sources conflict. High adds Khufu interior (900), Tutankhamun (700)/Seti I (2,000), Saqqara. Bring cards; some cashless.

budget.item: Aswan-Luxor car, felucca, birding boat, Philae boat, Uber/taxis/ferries, airport transfers
budget.notes: Car ~$100-120, felucca ~$15-25/boat-hour, birding boat ~$30-40, CAI pickup ~$20-25. High adds Egyptologist or Abu Simbel.
Local food (koshari, ful, grills) $3-8; tourist restaurants $15-25.
VOA $30 since Mar 2026, USD cash at CAI kiosk. E-visa visa2egypt.gov.eg $25 or $30 (sources conflict).

budget.item: Tips, SIM, water, optional IST pod, optional balloon
budget.notes: Includes share of YOTEL Air IST pod ~4h Dec 20 (~$100-150/room, ~$60 pp). Balloon ~$60-120 pp, not included. SIM ~$10.

booking.task: Price/book multi-city: TK10 + TK692 (Dec 19-21), MS849 CAI-NBO (Dec 27). Check MS849 Dec time (21:35/22:55/23:55).
Book guesthouses: Giza Dec 20-23 (held for ~04:00 Dec 21), Aswan Dec 23-25, Luxor Dec 25-27. Free cancellation.
Domestic flights: CAI-ASW Dec 23 AM; LXR-CAI Dec 27 early PM, land by ~17:00.
Giza guesthouse: pre-dawn CAI pickup. Aswan guesthouse: Luxor car, felucca, birding boat. Optional YOTEL Air IST pod Dec 20.
GEM tickets online (visit-gem.com only). Optional: Dec 26 balloon (licensed), Abu Simbel flight.
E-visa (visa2egypt.gov.eg) or $30 cash each for VOA. STEP; recheck advisory.
Carry USD cash (visa, small bills), fleece for cold nights.

fatigue: Dec 19: ~13h overnight flight. Dec 20: ~7h IST layover overnight. Dec 21: 2h25 flight, land ~03:30-04:30, ~45min road, sleep AM (heavy start, light PM). Dec 22: ~0.5h. Dec 23: ~3.5h (1h road + 1h25 flight + 0.5h transfer + waits). Dec 24: ~1h boats. Dec 25: ~4h road, temple breaks. Dec 26: ~0.5h. Dec 27: 1h05 flight + ~5-7h CAI wait + 5h red-eye (heavy). Dec 28: Nairobi rest. Road max ~4h/day (under 5h cap); light day after each long haul. Strain: IST layover + pre-dawn Cairo; Dec 27 + red-eye. Europe routing landing Cairo evening eases first if TK692 too harsh.
safety_short: Cairo, Luxor, Aswan: heavily policed tourist corridors, outside Do Not Travel zones. Real issues: touts, scams, traffic, stomach bugs.
